title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government response to a 2020 report on artificial intelligence and public standards outlines its plans to regulate AI in various sectors, such as healthcare and finance, to ensure public safety and trust. The government aims to develop and implement standards for AI used in public services, while also promoting innovation and economic growth.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual has created a policy to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in qualifications. The policy aims to ensure AI use in the qualifications sector is safe and fair.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This document assesses the use of copyrighted materials in the creation of artificial intelligence systems and examines potential copyright implications. It aims to provide guidance on the copyright impact of AI system development.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has issued a response to the House of Lords Select Committee's report on the need for improved safety and regulation of artificial intelligence in the country. The response outlines steps the government will take to address the concerns raised by the committee.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms and reference for a review into how artificial intelligence affects public standards. It also includes a section of frequently asked questions (FAQs) to guide the committee's assessment.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The Communication Services and Public Fundraising Regulation Policy (CSPL) has submitted evidence to an inquiry about the governance of Artificial Intelligence.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This policy aims to regulate medical products impacted by Artificial Intelligence. It will implement principles from the Artificial Intelligence White Paper to achieve this goal.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the defence organisation one of the world's most effective and efficient in using AI, while also being trusted and influential. It sets out to achieve this through a strategic approach to the development and use of AI in defence-related activities.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Transport artificial intelligence action plan is a government strategy to utilize AI technology in the transport sector, while addressing potential risks and challenges. This plan aims to work collaboratively with the transport industry to unlock the benefits of AI.

title: Copyright and artificial intelligence: progress report
description: A progress report on the use of copyright works in the development of AI systems, under Section 137 of the Data (Use and Access) Act.
summary: This policy document is a progress report on the use of copyrighted works in artificial intelligence system development, focusing on compliance with the Data (Use and Access) Act. It appears to address copyright concerns related to AI development.
